capabilities.claim_text: Extract database-neutral control-flow, handlers, ordered decisions, loops, calls, dynamic SQL, queries, mutations, transactions, cursors, result sets and returns from Db2 SQL PL, Oracle PL/SQL, SQL Server T-SQL, PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL and MySQL stored programs.
limitations: Organic estate validation is not yet established for each database dialect. Unclassified vendor extensions remain explicit opaque findings rather than invented semantics.
Synthetic fixture acceptance does not establish organic estate validation or commercial availability.

capabilities.claim_text: Generate non-authoritative readable technical BDD candidates when approved vocabulary and classification inputs are supplied.
limitations: Without approved vocabulary, output remains technical and requires vocabulary approval.

capabilities.claim_text: Generate typed invocation skeletons, technical expected effects, and explicit relational-data blockers.
limitations: Relational rows and setup/teardown SQL are not generated.

capabilities.claim_text: Cache an externally asserted baseline and manually compare candidate evidence, producing a violation candidate rather than an authoritative decision.
Reconcile supplied scripted, imported or adapter-produced execution records against static verification plans and emit non-authoritative contradiction candidates.
limitations: The reconciliation service is implemented. Live Db2 execution and production watcher adapters remain experimental/customer-integrated.

capabilities.claim_text: Capture Db2 catalog metadata or ingest DDL/JSON snapshots and resolve recursive view, synonym and base-relation lineage with explicit unresolved boundaries.
customer_input_requirements: Authorized Db2 catalog connection or customer-supplied DDL/JSON snapshot
limitations: Live capture requires the optional catalog adapter and customer authorization. Column-level view-expression lineage remains bounded by supplied view SQL and supported query parsing.

capabilities.claim_text: Infer non-authoritative direct SQL CALL composition candidates and validate digest-bound customer-approved composition contracts.
customer_input_requirements: Current upstream and downstream semantic digests
limitations: Direct source CALLs are inferred. External, event-driven and application orchestration still require customer contracts and cannot be auto-approved.

capabilities.claim_text: Compile executable Db2 setup and teardown SQL for a fail-closed base-table subset when complete catalog metadata, cleanup keys and approved values are available.
customer_input_requirements: Approved values or admissible deterministic scalar generation
limitations: Views, cycles, unsupported types, unresolved cleanup keys and unacknowledged constraints remain blocked. Trigger and temporal closure require additional authoritative metadata.

capabilities.claim_text: Review extracted procedures through decision requirements, ordered decision projections, scenarios, lineage, side effects and audit evidence, with commercial controls retained in the same offline console.
capabilities.display_name: Procedure review workbench and governed commercial console
limitations: The ordered decision table is a review projection, not a DMN execution artifact.
Model-driven What-If accepts explicit truth values for extracted predicate IDs; it does not evaluate raw business inputs or reimplement SQL.
Enterprise identity requires configured signed-header or OIDC/JWT evidence.

capabilities.claim_text: Render PASS, FAIL, CONDITIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE, NOT_EVALUATED and NOT_APPLICABLE checks from generated evidence.
limitations: Some PASS states require authoritative customer catalogs or contracts; absence of a finding never becomes PASS.

capabilities.claim_text: Visualize procedure, relation, effect, call and unresolved-boundary nodes from emitted analysis artifacts.
limitations: This is a generated evidence projection, not the designed full catalog-backed enterprise knowledge graph.

capabilities.claim_text: Generate offline SBOM, source-excluding support bundles, metering snapshots and immutable audit records.
limitations: Vulnerability scanning, signed release attestations and enterprise backup execution remain external deployment gates.

capabilities.claim_text: Plan required relation inputs, generated-column omissions and parent-before-child ordering from customer-supplied relation metadata.
limitations: No row values, setup SQL or teardown SQL are generated without approved scenario-to-relational constraints.

capabilities.claim_text: Evaluate digest-bound extracted decision models using explicit TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN assignments to extracted predicate evidence.
limitations: Inputs are technical predicate truth assignments, not raw business values. Partial rules produce INCONCLUSIVE outcomes.

capabilities.claim_text: Persist and search digest-bound procedure evidence graphs in a tenant-scoped SQLite WAL store.
limitations: This is an evidence graph store, not a full catalog-backed estate knowledge graph or graph database cluster.

capabilities.claim_text: Authenticate console users through fixed local identity, HMAC-signed trusted headers, or offline-verified OIDC/JWT tokens using pinned keys.
customer_input_requirements: Customer IdP issuer/audience/claim mapping and pinned verification key or signed-header secret
limitations: No live IdP discovery or enterprise directory provisioning is performed automatically.

capabilities.claim_text: Map complete routine bodies into the Atlas database-neutral semantic IR and produce decision, effect, call, relation, dynamic SQL, transaction, result-set, graph and scenario artifacts.
capabilities.display_name: Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL body semantics
limitations: Database-specific statements not yet classified are retained as explicit OPAQUE nodes with source evidence. No unsupported statement is silently discarded.
Synthetic fixture acceptance does not establish organic estate validation or commercial availability.

compatibility_notes: Legacy distribution db2-behavior-extraction-framework remains a compatibility identity through 3.0.0.
Legacy ojas_reconciler.db2_behavior namespace remains functional through 3.0.0.
Legacy DB2 and Ojas CLI aliases remain compatibility surfaces.

prohibited_datasheet_claims: Complete customer or estate knowledge graphs without authoritative catalog and composition evidence
Production falsification reports or automatic contradiction promotion
Measured performance, concurrency, or deadlock guarantees
Raw-input business simulation from the technical What-If evaluator
Universal executable fixture generation outside the admitted metadata subset
Exhaustive support for every vendor extension when the emitted Atlas IR contains OPAQUE nodes or error findings
